captions.detailed: A full-suspension mountain bike front fork assembly with a dual-stanchion design and integrated handlebars. The lower assembly consists of two thick, black prismatic lower legs joined at the bottom, which slide over two silver inner stanchion tubes. The stanchions connect to a black crown bridge, from which a vertical silver steerer tube extends upward. A grey ahead stem clamps onto the steerer tube, holding a wide, slightly swept-back black handlebar with cylindrical grips.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a full-suspension mountain bike front fork and handlebar assembly. The model should feature lower outer legs, sliding inner stanchions, a crown bridge, a tapered steerer tube, an ahead stem, and wide flat handlebars with grips, utilizing realistic black and metallic silver materials.
captions.factory: Construct the fork legs and stanchions using Cylinder primitives, translating them laterally to form the dual-leg structure. Create the crown bridge by combining box/cylinder primitives or a lofted profile, and join it to the vertical steerer tube. Model the ahead stem with a central clamp box and a forward extension cylinder, then create the swept-back handlebars using a series of angled cylinders or a swept path, capped with wider cylinder grips. Define a prismatic joint between the lower legs and the inner stanchions to simulate suspension travel.
